title: Mommy Forgot
vol: Mommy Is Human Too · Book Five
verse: Everyone falls down sometimes. What matters is that we get back up and make it right.

pages.text:
On Monday, Jojo said it once. On Tuesday, said it twice:
"There's Show-and-Tell on Thursday, Mom!" And Mommy said, "How nice!"

She wrote it on a sticky note and stuck it on the door.
But sticky notes fall off sometimes and hide beneath the floor.

Then Thursday came in sideways — with a spill, a scramble, a rush,
a missing shoe, a barking dog, a hunt for one lost brush.

They got to school. The bell had rung. And Jojo turned around.
His hands were empty. And his eyes went slowly to the ground.

"It's Show-and-Tell," he said so soft that Mommy barely heard.
And something in her stomach dropped. She couldn't find a word.

She had forgotten. Truly. And there wasn't much to say.
No busy morning, no lost note, could give him back his day.

She knelt right there beside the door and looked him in the eye.
"I forgot. It mattered to you. And I'm not going to lie —

I could tell you I was busy. I could tell you it's been rough.
But you told me twice on purpose. And I should have been enough.

Forgetting doesn't mean you matter less. That isn't true.
It means my head was crowded — and I let it crowd out you.

So here is what I'll do," she said. "I'll set a ringing sound,
and put your Thursday in my phone, where it can't fall to the ground.

And when we're home, you'll show me first. You'll tell me every part.
Because a thing that matters to you matters to my heart."

Then Jojo thought about it. Then he gave a little shrug.
"Okay, Mom." And he squeezed her hand. And then he gave a hug.

Because "I'm sorry" isn't just a word you say and leave.
It's what you do on Friday. It's the promise you believe.

So Mommy tries, and Mommy trips, and starts the day anew —
and Mommy still forgets sometimes… because she's human too.

items: Have you ever forgotten something important? What happened?
How can someone fix a mistake?
What helps our family remember things?
Make a family reminder board for important days.
Write a promise you will keep this week.
